title: hermai: a hermeneutic explainable AI library
description: Contextual, narrative and actionable explanations for machine learning models: local explanations with counterfactuals, general surrogate explanations and narrative summaries. The repository also contains the reproduction code of the Hermeneutic Circle Test (Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction, 2026).
